text:
Ivy (Growth): Quick idea: run a small "field lab" launch — 45-min hands-on webinar + 4 short launch posts + staggered starter-credit experiment. Need to align copy, routing, and onboarding templates.
Noah (Design): "field lab" sounds good. two creative angles: "Get to production" (fast path) vs "Optimize inference economics" (value). I'll mock 2 hero cards.
Ravi (Product): For the webinar, make it a mini-build: 20min walkthrough, 20min lab, 5min Q&A. deliverable = working sample and 3 prompt templates. give attendees a code-first prompt pack.
Lina (Eng): Routing mechanics: tag registrants with cohort=fieldlab-apr and add attribute credit_bucket set at signup for randomization. route heavy users (>1500 tokens in 7 days) to sales; otherwise send automated follow-up.
signup-bot: Form live -> 58 regs in 2h, conversion from ad 4.1% :sparkles:
Ivy (Growth): Draft social copy — shortform + longform variants. Please edit:
```
Short A: "Ship an LLM feature in hours with Redwood Inference. Join our Field Lab + grab starter credits: https://redwood.ai/fieldlab"
Short B: "Cut inference cost, not quality. Field Lab: build, deploy, and measure. RSVP: https://redwood.ai/fieldlab"
Long: "Join our hands-on Field Lab where engineers will build a small LLM-driven feature from prompt to deploy. Attendees get starter credits and a prompt pack. Seats limited."
```
Noah (Design): A is snappy for X, B better for LinkedIn. I'll design two hero gifs + a benchmark mini-card showing relative cost/latency to our baseline.
Ravi (Product): Experiment idea: credit timing A/B: GIVE_NOW vs GIVE_AFTER. Hypothesis: GIVE_NOW raises attendance but GIVE_AFTER increases post-webinar usage. let's randomize equally.
Lina (Eng): Implementation note: add credit_timing param to signup payload. sample payload: `{"cohort":"fieldlab-apr","credit_timing":"GIVE_NOW|GIVE_AFTER"}`. I can emit event hooks to analytics.
Ivy (Growth): Routing JSON proposal (keep it simple):
```json
{
  "source": "fieldlab_form",
  "tags": ["cohort:fieldlab-apr","launch:fieldlab"],
  "route_to": "growth-sales",
  "route_if": {"7d_tokens": ">=1500"},
  "fallback": "automated-onboarding-email"
}
```
Ravi (Product): Add a note: if growth-sales queue > 30 leads, fall back to a high-touch nurture path.
Noah (Design): For prompt templates, I'll draft 4 focused templates: customer-support summarizer, internal knowledge assistant, code helper, and meeting-notes extractor. short examples will ship with the pack.
Lina (Eng): I'll capture 50th/95th/99th pctl latency and per-token cost for the small model and attach to the benchmark card. also will wire the randomization flag and route rules.
signup-bot: Analytics update: ad creative B -> CTR 3.8%, creative A -> CTR 4.3% in early test.
Ivy (Growth): Nice. Metrics to track: registrations, attendance rate, 7d tokens, 30d retention, activation rate (>=1500 tokens). primary KPI = activation rate within 7d. secondary KPI = cost-per-activated-user.
Ravi (Product): I'll own agenda + prompt pack. Lina, can you provide the infra numbers by EOD?
Lina (Eng): yes, pushing numbers and the event schema by EOD.
Noah (Design): I'll deliver hero gifs + benchmark card by tomorrow noon.
Ivy (Growth): Great — action items: Noah (assets), Ravi (agenda/templates), Lina (routing & metrics), me (ads + tracking). I'll schedule a dry run 24h before the event. Thanks :rocket:
